test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

She always / invite me / to / dinner.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **invite me**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• This error lies in the subject-verb agreement, where the verb does not agree with the subject in terms of number.
 
• **Subject-verb agreement** means that a subject and its verb must be both singular or both plural.
 
• A singular subject takes a singular verb. A plural subject takes a plural verb.
 
• So, the correct verb form should be "**invites**" instead of "**invite**" to match the subject "**She**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Corrected sentence:** *She always invites me to dinner.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**She always**" is grammatically correct.
 
• "**to**" is a preposition and is used correctly in the sentence.
 
• "**dinner**" is a noun and is used correctly in the sentence.
